Hero.title: Saint George's HEMA School
Hero.description: We study and practice the fighting systems recorded in historical treatises, guided by the same manuals used by masters of old.

About.title: About
About.text: We practice Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA). Historical fencing is a type of martial art distinguished by its specificity - the use of replicas of historical weaponry, similar in size, weight, and other characteristics to the originals, as well as the study of techniques from European martial arts passed down to us by masters of Medieval, Renaissance, and Modern times, such as Johannes Liechtenauer, Fiore dei Liberi, Camillo Agrippa, Alfred Hutton, and many others.

Training.title: Training
Training.weaponsIntro: Currently, we conduct training in four types of weapons:
weaponsList: Longsword, also known as the "Federschwert" in the German tradition
Italian rapier, as well as rapier and dagger (dagger for the off-hand)
Sword and shield (buckler) of the 13th century
